x: Gordon was well backed up by Shipley (3rd), Maclean & Shippen (6th), Forey (8th) and Miller (12th).
The home club were also winners of the Junior match. Thresher, Heck, Forey and Penny were our scoring quartette.
Kerr, Robinson, Miller, Thresher Black & Forey is only 22 yrs., so bearing in mind the success they have already shown this could become a Championship-winning combination for many years to come.
Our "B", "C", and "D" teams also produced some good performances notably from Maclean, Sawyer and Forey, and all but the "C" team closed in.
Sandwiched between Black and Forey the four runners on "trial" were Davies, Dabbs, Thresher, and Miller. The two Johns won the day, but there was little else of interest to Belgrave.
